messages.author: 839dfa09184985a5
messages.subject: DoubleVectorView naming
parts: In order to generalize OperandsAndPartials, I had to generalize DoubleVectorView so you have to specify an additional typename such as double, var etc. so it'll assign a new VectorView with that type. That being said, should we rename DoubleVectorView to something more fitting?

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] DoubleVectorView naming
parts:
On Jun 10, 2014, at 2:24 AM, Peter Li <li.pe...@gmail.com> wrote:

> In order to generalize OperandsAndPartials, I had to generalize DoubleVectorView so you have to specify an additional typename such as double, var etc. so it'll assign a new VectorView with that type. That being said, should we rename DoubleVectorView to something more fitting?

Absolutely! Daniel and I had talked about that before.

As I recall, there are two vector view classes, one that
actually builds a vector and one that's literally a view.
Rationalizing those names to mention their function would
be good.

- Bob

messages.author: 839dfa09184985a5
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] DoubleVectorView naming
parts:
Ok, so currently VectorView allows us to view whatever as a vector (i.e. calling with things like x[i]). And DoubleVectorView assigns doubles as intermediate values (but now it assigns whatever return type we specify as intermediate values). 

Perhaps we should rename this to ScalarVectorView (I saw Ben mention this in another email)?

Rationalizing those names to mention their function would

- Bob

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] DoubleVectorView naming
parts:
VectorView sounds fine to keep as a name for the expression
template wrapper.

I would prefer something like VectorBuilder<double> for what we now
call DoubleVectorView. And then have it generalize to whatever
type you need to wrap. I'm not that picky about the name as long
as it's not misleading, but DoubleVectorView isn't just a view, so
the "View" part of the name should be changed.

- Bob
